author: China Insights
description:
During a military exercise, a Chinese Communist Party infantry fighting vehicle fired a smoke grenade that directly hit an observation platform packed with officials. Whether this was a mistake or a deliberate act, the incident is sure to keep Xi Jinping up at night. Footage released by foreign media reveals that during the Two Sessions, Xi Jinping received extraordinary personal security arrangements, with staff exercising a level of care comparable to hand-crafting 5-nanometer chips — exposing the unmistakable mindset of a dictator. Meanwhile, tens of thousands gathered to bid farewell to Zhang Xuefeng, raising questions about the shocking response from Suzhou authorities.
